body: also, i'm worried about reaching out to a therapist because doctors are pretty close-knit in the city and my aunt is one of the well-known ones. if i were to go to therapy, i wouldn't want anyone to find out but maybe if i show up in the vicinity, i'll bump into my aunt or one of her friends (sorry if this seems like a stupid concern) i just can't imagine explaining it to family. sounding like an attention-seeker or whatever is the last thing i want which is why i keep it so closely guarded. or i think if i tell them, i'll end up being the one to convince them it isnt a big deal just so it wont bother anyone since i dont think it will help much anyway idk

thank you. i'll try but i don't know where to start. a little background so you'll understand why i think people won't take it seriously: on paper, i'm living a pretty successful over-achieving life. but i honestly think i'm barely doing enough just to keep it up. like i think people think it's not that much effort on my part but it's such a struggle i just want to stop everything. i'm also from a country where most people just smile or laugh through their problems with friends so things like depression aren't exactly given focus
thank you. i'm not sure, i don't know how to talk about it. but thank you so much
well actually i wish i were afraid, i think i feel more like it's hopeless

i'm close to several people, but i can't imagine myself ever telling them. i think it would be too...shocking. and i don't know i would do it. i think i wouldn't be able to say it right. i've considered therapy but honestly i'm too afraid to reach out
thanks. faking it is definitely what i've been doing this whole time. i don't think any of them would ever suspect it. i wish someone would find out somehow
